items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: He was a heck of a piano player. So he played with me. He played with my little outfit.

ctx.x: I see Vince Guaraldi’s name on here.
Well Vince Guaraldi, he played for “Peanuts.” Did you ever hear that —
